answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 160928 Country: India Title: I am suffering from back pain, neck pain Question: I am suffering from back pain, neck pain I can’t sit in office more than one hour and ever time sick lick cold, fever, headache and allergic, please tell any dua or zikr. Answer ID: 160928 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1038/832/SD=8/1439) Read the following dua seven times and blow over your whole body: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَني Also read Ya Salamu Ya Salamu ( يا سلام يا سلام ) extensively and also see some expert physician. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
